notes.title: new update ！！！
notes.content: vehicle，day and night，craft and construction，lobby env changes

notes.title: Bosses can dodge attacks
notes.content:
1. Bosses can dodge attacks.
2. Change the island's sunshine brightness.
3. Change the village 3d art.Rewards can be collected in the village.

notes.title: Day and night cycle.Fix server listen failure.Improve startup speed
notes.content:
1. Day and night cycle (night, day), within one hour,
2. Fix server listen failed, (caused by incompatibility of steam socket plug-in, now fixed, sorry)
3. Improve game startup speed

notes.title: New content added and improved
notes.content:
Added 3 new monsters to challenge anywhere.Added some boss special skills and improved scene art.
Improvement:
1. Reduces boss health
2. Reduce game data size
3. Improved mouse display and hiding
4. Improved character Death animation

notes.title: Improved sound effects and other experiences
notes.content:
1. Add shooting sound (flight, field sound, defeat effect, bass)
2. Fixed inability to hear monster movement attack sounds
3. Fixed lobby music failure bug
4. Add ambient sounds
5. Add boss health bar
6. Adjust monster position
7. Improvement of UI Foucs in the hall
8. add UE4Logo

notes.title: language localization early support ，game guidelines updated in Store page
notes.content: 1.localization of the early support: ***（English，Deutsch，Le français，日本語，русский，한국어）***. It will be improved in the future and consider adding more language support.   2. Store page has been updated with some game guidelines, which will be updated into the game later

notes.title: Thanks for your time and attention, the early version of cute adventure has been released
notes.content:
1. Due to my previous development experience, I will steadily advance the development process in the future and push important progress to messages.
2. I welcome your feedback and Suggestions
3. Thank you
